Question
========
What is the "paradox of inequality" described by Mijs (2021)?

Answerlist
----------
* In more unequal societies, people are more likely to explain inequality by merit
* In more unequal societies, people are more aware of structural causes
* People overestimate inequality
* Inequality has no effect on beliefs

Solution
========
Inequality and the belief in meritocracy go hand in hand; people in more equal countries see structural causes more often.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
